Chapter 848: Chapter 36: Stepping into the Eleventh Level (End of this volume, please subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan’s Consciousness Incarnation was reflecting within his inner world. Compared to the modest expanse of barely over two hundred million miles before the breakthrough, the current inner world had strengthened by an unknown multitude.

“99% of the Chaos Void Origin Power, I haven’t completely absorbed it, instead, I’ve accumulated it deep within my inner world…”

Lin Yuan looked thoughtful.

Tearing through rifts spanning hundreds of light-years to welcome the descent of the Chaos Void Origin, Lin Yuan’s breakthrough to the tenth layer created a disturbance no less significant than the impact of striving for the ultimate Level Eleven.

The Chaos Void Origin he ultimately withstood was no less than that of a Level Eleven making the ultimate breakthrough.

Once successful, internally evolving their world to a universe, undergoing an ultimate metamorphosis of their life essence, the size of that inner universe would eventually stretch from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of light-years.

But Lin Yuan’s inner world came to a halt at a diameter of six hundred billion miles, mainly because the vast majority of the Chaos Void Origin Power was not thoroughly absorbed.

Due to not undergoing the metamorphosis, a Level Eleven aiming for the ultimate status would swiftly absorb the accumulated Chaos Void Origin.

But without the ultimate metamorphosis, those energies from the Chaos Void remained sunken deep within Lin Yuan’s inner world.

“This is good too, all of it will become my foundation, so that when I truly make the push for the ultimate, my inner world’s final size, I estimate, will surpass the range of tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of light-years.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even more so, this accumulation of substantial Chaos Void Origin has vastly elevated his base strength, that when he truly strives for the ultimate, the Chaos Void’s assessment of him will heighten, the fissures torn will be more vast, and the infusing Chaos Void Origin will reach an inconceivable level.

…

“Does my inner world still deserve to be called a ‘world’?”

Lin Yuan looked down upon his six hundred billion mile diameter inner world, with endless Chaos Void energy pouring in, continuously metamorphosing his inner world, further unfolding more Spatial Layers, and so on.

“It lies somewhere between an inner world and an inner universe.”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself. His current inner world far surpassed the regular notion of an inner world, yet it didn’t quite reach the magnitude of a Supreme Being’s inner universe.

…

“Strength after the breakthrough?”

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan began to focus precisely on his sensations.

His physical body and soul had improved more than a hundredfold compared to before the breakthrough.

But the most critical was his inner world, vast at six hundred billion miles in diameter. You should know, the inner worlds of other Level Eleven beings, depending on the nobility of their racial bloodlines, range from tens of millions to a few tens of millions of miles in diameter.

And Lin Yuan?

A direct six hundred billion miles in diameter?

In front of Lin Yuan, ordinary Level Eleven beings are feeble like ants.

According to Lin Yuan’s previous standards of assessment, if a Level Eleven Perfect combat strength is denoted as ten.

Then, Lin Yuan before his breakthrough had a strength probably around one hundred.

Now, having stepped into Level Eleven, his strength has already surpassed ten thousand.

Ten thousand and one hundred, at first glance, seem to be just a hundredfold increase, but in practice, it’s not calculated like that. A hundred warriors each with a strength of one hundred, when combined, would be crushed by a being of strength ten thousand.

Not to mention a hundred, even a thousand or ten thousand, faced with an entity of strength ten thousand, the outcome would be the same, with no capacity to resist.

Simply put, with Lin Yuan’s current combat strength, he can completely be regarded as a unique existence between Level Eleven and Level Twelve.

The gap between Level Eleven and Level Twelve seems as vast as a chasm.

But the gap between Level Eleven and Lin Yuan is almost as insurmountable.

Even a Level Eleven Perfect Legend lifeform wielding a Supreme weapon, in front of Lin Yuan, could, at best, barely cling on to life by the merit of the weapon itself.

And if that Supreme weapon were not of a defensive nature but offensive instead, survival would most likely be out of reach.

“Now, only Level Twelve could pose a real threat to me, I guess.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself while simultaneously looking up towards a certain region.

“All nine Supreme Beings have come.”

Lin Yuan vaguely sensed nine vast presences.

Before the breakthrough, Lin Yuan simply could not detect the arrival of Supreme Beings. It was only after being informed by the Supreme Being Xia Qin that he commenced the breakthrough.

But now, with advancement in realm and a grasp over space and time, Lin Yuan could vaguely lock onto the auras of the Supreme Beings.

Of course, this was because the nine Supreme Beings from human civilization were incarnations, and they did not specifically conceal their aura.

“It’s time to meet the Supreme Beings.”

Lin Yuan rose to his feet, emerged from the depths of the Spatial Layers, and headed toward the nine human civilization Supreme Beings.

Without the presence of nine Supreme Beings, Lin Yuan’s breakthrough would have been known by the Ten Thousand Universe Races, and those alien Supreme Beings would definitely interfere.

Since the birth of the universe, any Level Eleven Perfect being before making a breakthrough to the ultimate would seek a Supreme Being as support.

The first Supreme Being of human civilization came to be in this way, seeking an ultimate entity, paying many prices for its protection, and finally managing to step into Level Twelve.

…

The river of time flows on mightily.

Supreme Beings from the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and many others patiently wait.

In the distant horizon, other Supreme Beings loom, their towering figures vague yet discernible.

Supreme Beings from the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and other Level Twelve powerhouses intend to snipe the newly risen Supreme Being from human civilization, while the other ultimate entities are happy to watch the excitement.

“Hm?”

“It’s been such a long time, why is there no fluctuation in the river of time?”

The Supreme Beings from the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan frown slightly, realizing there can be only one reason for this.

That is the human evolver attempting the ultimate has ultimately failed.

A failure to reach the ultimate would erase all of oneself, naturally preventing the ‘landing.’

“Failed?”

“That makes sense, achieving the ultimate is not so simple.”

“We’ve all been too anxious.”

The ultimate existences from the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan exchange glances and let out a slight sigh of relief.

If possible, they wouldn’t want to snipe either, because it would mean engaging in a desperate fight with the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization.

The battles between Supreme Beings, skirmishes at the ultimate level, mostly result in significant self-harm while killing the enemy; there’s little meaning to them, especially with a few crazed Supreme Beings from human civilization who, if really pushed, might resort to self-destructive measures.

So.

The current outcome.

Is undoubtedly the best.

The human evolver who attempted the ultimate has failed.

For the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan, this means one less enemy to worry about, and they also don’t need to clash with the Supreme Beings of human civilization, making it perfect.

The only thing that puzzles the Supreme Beings from the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan is how ‘easily’ the human evolver has failed.

With the foundation of human civilization, since they dared to let their own make the ultimate attempt, they must have made many preparations, even in failure, certainly causing ripples or even waves in the river of time.

However, just now.

From beginning to end, no Supreme Being felt any surge on the river of time.

This means that the human evolver barely started the ultimate challenge before they failed, leading to such tranquility in the river of time.

Though puzzled, the Supreme Beings from the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan don’t dwell on it, for causing an infusion of Origin Power from the Chaos Void would inevitably lead to the ultimate leap.

And if the ultimate leap were successful, it would lead to a ‘landing.’

Now, without a ‘landing,’ it means failure.

Despite their doubts, the Supreme Beings from the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan grasp the fundamental logic of cause and effect.

That is, the human evolver attempting the ultimate did not ultimately step into Level Twelve.

Otherwise, there would have been a ‘landing.’

Not stepping into Level Twelve means a complete downfall.

…

Milky Way Star Region.

The hearts of the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization remain unsettled for a long time.

They watch the cracks in the Chaos Void heal swiftly, at a loss for words for a moment.

“This kid, too frightening.”

An Ancient Power Supreme Being shakes their head slightly; it’s not often that something can frighten Supreme Beings, but now it’s clear that all nine Supreme Beings of human civilization have been significantly alarmed.

In fact, if other alien Supreme Beings knew that the commotion just now was caused merely by a Level Ten challenging Level Eleven, they would likely be appalled.

“My human civilization has given birth to a remarkable existence.”

This thought suddenly emerges in the hearts of the remaining Supreme Beings.
